sara: Newbie reported a crash only in production bundles when calling the JS SDK from an edge function. Dev server is fine.

leo: which bundler/minifier? repro steps please.

sara: Repro (minimal):
```
git clone git@github.com:internal/repro/redwood-edge-bundler-minify.git
cd redwood-edge-bundler-minify
npm ci
# build with webpack+terser prod config
npm run build:prod
# serve static files to emulate edge bundle
npx serve dist -l 4000
# request the edge api
curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

sara: Error: `ReferenceError: Headers is not defined` coming from SDK auth/retry wrapper. Stack points to `node_modules/redwood/dist/index.mjs`.

maya: Sounds like a missing runtime global. Edge should expose Headers. Can you paste the bundled snippet?

sara: In the built vendor chunk terser folded the guard. Snippet:```js
var maybeAttach=function(){if(typeof Request!=='undefined'){return}else{globalThis.Headers=globalThis.Headers||function(){}}};
```

sara: The attach helper lived behind a conditional and with `sideEffects: false` + terser const-folding it got dropped for the code paths that reference retry. The retry wrapper then referenced `Headers` and crashed.

leo: Any difference between rollup/vite?

sara: Vite dev works. Rollup+esbuild minify kept the helper. Only webpack+terser (prod) reproduces reliably.

maya: Typescript issue also reported by the user: TS complains `Property 'retries' does not exist on type 'GenerateOptions'` when they pass `retry: { retries: 2 }`. Looks like published d.ts for ESM missed the extended retry types.

leo: Quick local fixes we tried: 1) Explicit import in app entry: `import { ensureEdgeGlobals } from 'redwood/edge-shim'; ensureEdgeGlobals();` 2) Set `optimizeDeps.include=['redwood']` for Vite dev (not helpful for webpack prod) 3) Pin `retry: 0`. All workarounds but bad for DX.

maya: For an SDK-side fix: move edge shim into a dedicated file that's always referenced by the published ESM exports, or ensure the guard uses a runtime check that minifiers can't const-fold. Also update `types` publishing to include retry union in ESM `.d.ts`.

leo: Action items:
- SDK: split and export `edge-shim` from ESM entry and include it in `exports` map (leo)
- SDK: republish d.ts that includes `retry` typings for ESM entry (maya)
- Devex: add quickstart FAQ + workaround snippet and mention webpack/terser caveat (onboard-docs)
- CI: add smoke job that builds sampleapp with webpack/rollup/vite prod configs and curls the endpoint (ci-bot)

ci-bot: created ticket RED-4021 to add bundler smoke tests to CI (https://internal/ci/RED-4021) :gear:

onboard-docs: Drafted FAQ blurb to add to quickstart: "If you see missing Request/Headers after a production bundle, import the SDK shim or include the SDK in your bundler optimizations. Example: `import { ensureEdgeGlobals } from 'redwood/edge-shim'; ensureEdgeGlobals();`"

sara: I'll open a minimal repro repo under internal/sampleapps and link to RED-4021. Will also add a tiny PR for quickstart with the workaround while SDK ships a proper patch.

leo: thanks. I'll prototype the export change and add a small unit build test. Also will ensure the publishing pipeline emits correct ESM `.d.ts` files.

sara: tagging this `edge-bundler-interop` and `types-esm` in the issue. Will follow up when I have the repro link. :rocket:
